13.sabates_a: And our Lord God said to the woman: Why hast thou done this? Who answered: The serpent deceived me, and I did eat.
13.madueke_b: And our Lord God said to the woman: Why hast thou done this? Who answered: The serpent deceived me, and I did eat.

14.s_dismas: And our Lord God ſaid to the ſerpent: Becauſe thou haſt done this thing, accurſed art thou among al catle, & beaſts of the earth: vpon thy breſt ſhalt thou goe, & earth ſhalt thou eate al the dayes of thy life.
14.odr_com: And our Lord God said to the serpent: Because thou hast done this thing, accursed art thou among al catle, & beasts of the earth: vpon thy brest shalt thou goe, & earth shalt thou eate al the dayes of thy life.
14.sabates_a: And our Lord God said to the serpent: Because thou hast done this thing, accursed art thou among all cattle, and beasts of the earth: upon thy breast shalt thou go, & earth shalt thou eat all the days of thy life.
14.madueke_b: And our Lord God said to the serpent: Because thou hast done this thing, accursed art thou among all cattle, and beasts of the earth: upon thy breast shalt thou go, & earth shalt thou eat all the days of thy life.

15.s_dismas: I wil put enmyties betwen thee & the woman, and thy ſeed and the ſeed of her: ſhe ſhal bruiſe thy head in peeces, & thou ſhalt lye in waite of her heele.
15.odr_com: I wil put enmyties betwen thee & the woman, and thy seed and the seed of her: she shal bruise thy head in peeces, & thou shalt lye in waite of her heele.
15.sabates_a: I will put enmity between thee & the woman, & thy seed and the seed of her: she shall bruise thy head in pieces, and thou shalt lie in wait of her heel.
15.madueke_b: I will put enmity between thee & the woman, & thy seed and the seed of her: she shall bruise thy head in pieces, and thou shalt lie in wait of her heel.

16.s_dismas: To the woman alſo he ſaid: I wil multiplie thy trauailes, and thy child bearinges: in trauaile ſhalt thou bring forth children, and thou ſhalt be vnder thy huſbands power, and he ſhal haue dominion ouer thee.
16.odr_com: To the woman also he said: I wil multiplie thy trauailes, and thy child bearinges: in trauaile shalt thou bring forth children, and thou shalt be vnder thy husbands power, and he shal haue dominion ouer thee.
16.sabates_a: To the woman also he said: I will multiply thy travails and thy child-bearings: in travail shalt thou bring forth children, and thou shalt be under thy husband's power, and he shall have dominion over thee.
16.madueke_b: To the woman also he said: I will multiply thy travails and thy child-bearings: in travail shalt thou bring forth children, and thou shalt be under thy husband's power, and he shall have dominion over thee.

17.s_dismas: And to Adam he ſaid: Becauſe thou haſt heard the voice of thy wife, and haſt eaten of the tree, whereof I cõmanded thee, that thou ſhouldeſt not eate, curſed is the earth in thy woorke: with much toyling ſhalt thou eate thereof al the dayes of thy life.
17.odr_com: And to Adam he said: Because thou hast heard the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee, that thou shouldest not eate, cursed is the earth in thy woorke: with much toyling shalt thou eate thereof al the dayes of thy life.
17.sabates_a: And to Adam he said: Because thou hast heard the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree wherefore I commanded thee that thou shouldst not eat, cursed is the earth in thy work: with much toiling shalt thou eat thereof all the days of thy life.
17.madueke_b: And to Adam he said: Because thou hast heard the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree wherefore I commanded thee that thou shouldst not eat, cursed is the earth in thy work: with much toiling shalt thou eat thereof all the days of thy life.

18.s_dismas: Thornes and thyſtles ſhal it bring forth to thee, & thou ſhalt eate the herbes of the earth.
18.odr_com: Thornes and thystles shal it bring forth to thee, & thou shalt eate the herbes of the earth.
18.sabates_a: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat the herbs of the earth.
18.madueke_b: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat the herbs of the earth.

19.s_dismas: In the ſweat of thy face ſhalt thou eate bread, til thou returne to earth, of which thou waſt taken: becauſe duſt thou art, and into duſt thou ſhalt returne.
19.odr_com: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eate bread, til thou returne to earth, of which thou wast taken: because dust thou art, and into dust thou shalt returne.
19.sabates_a: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return to earth, of which thou wast taken: because dust thou art, and into dust thou shalt return.
19.madueke_b: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return to earth, of which thou wast taken: because dust thou art, and into dust thou shalt return.

20.s_dismas: And Adam called the name of his wife, Eue: for becauſe ſhe was mother of al the liuing.
20.odr_com: And Adam called the name of his wife, Eue: for because she was mother of al the liuing.
20.sabates_a: And Adam called the name of his wife, Eve: for because she was mother of all the living.
20.madueke_b: And Adam called the name of his wife, Eve: for because she was mother of all the living.

21.s_dismas: Our Lord God alſo made for Adam and his wife garments of ſkynnes, and clothed them.
21.odr_com: Our Lord God also made for Adam and his wife garments of skynnes, and clothed them.
21.sabates_a: Our Lord God also made for Adam and his wife garments of skins, and clothed them:
21.madueke_b: Our Lord God also made for Adam and his wife garments of skins, and clothed them:

22.s_dismas: And ſaid: Loe Adam is become as it were one of vs, knowing good & euil: now therfore leſt perhapes he reach forth his hand, and take alſo of the tree of life, & eate, and liue for euer.
22.odr_com: And said: Loe Adam is become as it were one of vs, knowing good & euil: now therfore lest perhapes he reach forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, & eate, and liue for euer.
22.sabates_a: And said: Lo Adam is become as it were one of us, knowing good & evil: now therefore lest perhaps he reach forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever.
22.madueke_b: And said: Lo Adam is become as it were one of us, knowing good & evil: now therefore lest perhaps he reach forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever.

23.s_dismas: And our Lord God ſent him out of the paradiſe of pleaſure, to worke the earth of which he was taken.
23.odr_com: And our Lord God sent him out of the paradise of pleasure, to worke the earth of which he was taken.
23.sabates_a: And our Lord God sent him out of the Paradise of pleasure, to work the earth of which he was taken.
23.madueke_b: And our Lord God sent him out of the Paradise of pleasure, to work the earth of which he was taken.

24.s_dismas: And he caſt out Adam: and placed before the paradiſe of pleaſure Cherubins, & a flaming, and a turning ſworde, for to keepe the way of the tree of life.
24.odr_com: And he cast out Adam: and placed before the paradise of pleasure Cherubins, & a flaming, and a turning sworde, for to keepe the way of the tree of life.
24.sabates_a: And he cast out Adam, and placed before the Paradise of pleasure Cherubins, and a flaming and a turning sword, for to keep the way of the tree of life.
24.madueke_b: And he cast out Adam, and placed before the Paradise of pleasure Cherubins, and a flaming and a turning sword, for to keep the way of the tree of life.

janvier_by_verse.1: But the serpent also was more subtile than all the beasts of the earth, which our Lord God had made. Which said to the woman: Why hath God commanded you, that you should not eat of every tree of Paradise?
janvier_by_verse.2: To whom the woman answered: Of the fruit of the trees that are in Paradise we do eat:
janvier_by_verse.3: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of Paradise, God hath commanded us that we should not eat: and that we should not touch it, lest perhaps we die.
janvier_by_verse.4: And the serpent said to the woman: No, you shall not die the death.
janvier_by_verse.5: For God doth know that in what day soever you shall eat thereof, your eyes shall be opened: and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
janvier_by_verse.6: The woman therefore saw that the tree was good to eat, and fair to the eyes, and delectable to behold: and she took of the fruit thereof, & did eat, & gave to her husband, who did eat.
janvier_by_verse.7: And the eyes of them both were opened: and when they perceived themselves to be naked, they sowed together leaves of a fig tree, and made themselves aprons.
janvier_by_verse.8: And hearing the voice of our Lord God walking in Paradise at the afternoon air, Adam hid himself, and so did his wife from the face of our Lord God, amidst the trees of Paradise.
janvier_by_verse.9: And our Lord God called Adam, and said to him: Where art thou?
janvier_by_verse.10: Who said: I heard thy voice in Paradise: and I feared, because I was naked, and I hid me.
janvier_by_verse.11: To whom he said: And who hath told thee that thou wast naked, but that thou hast eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldst not eat?
janvier_by_verse.12: And Adam said: The woman which thou gavest me to be my fellow-companion, gave me of the tree, & I did eat.
janvier_by_verse.13: And our Lord God said to the woman: Why hast thou done this? Who answered: The serpent deceived me, and I did eat.
janvier_by_verse.14: And our Lord God said to the serpent: Because thou hast done this thing, accursed art thou among all cattle, and beasts of the earth: upon thy breast shalt thou go, & earth shalt thou eat all the days of thy life.
janvier_by_verse.15: I will put enmity between thee & the woman, & thy seed and the seed of her: she shall bruise thy head in pieces, and thou shalt lie in wait of her heel.
janvier_by_verse.16: To the woman also he said: I will multiply thy travails and thy child-bearings: in travail shalt thou bring forth children, and thou shalt be under thy husband's power, and he shall have dominion over thee.
janvier_by_verse.17: And to Adam he said: Because thou hast heard the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree wherefore I commanded thee that thou shouldst not eat, cursed is the earth in thy work: with much toiling shalt thou eat thereof all the days of thy life.
janvier_by_verse.18: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to thee, and thou shalt eat the herbs of the earth.
janvier_by_verse.19: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return to earth, of which thou wast taken: because dust thou art, and into dust thou shalt return.
janvier_by_verse.20: And Adam called the name of his wife, Eve: for because she was mother of all the living.
janvier_by_verse.21: Our Lord God also made for Adam and his wife garments of skins, and clothed them:
janvier_by_verse.22: And said: Lo Adam is become as it were one of us, knowing good & evil: now therefore lest perhaps he reach forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever.
janvier_by_verse.23: And our Lord God sent him out of the Paradise of pleasure, to work the earth of which he was taken.
janvier_by_verse.24: And he cast out Adam, and placed before the Paradise of pleasure Cherubins, and a flaming and a turning sword, for to keep the way of the tree of life.
